title: Strict site-system and coefficient-functor data before taking the colimit
statement: Under all the hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-site-system-strictification, there exist F, Q, e, theta and v′ with every asserted site, equivalence, transition and coefficient compatibility property. This statement omits the existence of L and V and every colimit assertion. Definitions of precoverages and morphisms of sites are those of def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology. The output Q_i has finite indexed composition and finite indexed base change [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage], rather than the unrestricted indexed axioms; all other hypotheses and conclusions remain those of the Lean declaration.

source.place: Tag 004A; categorical construction applied fibrewise, site clauses as in the original strictification proof

proof.text: Use the explicit pair-category diagram and evaluation/section equivalences. The gamma and delta cocycles prove the strict transition and coefficient equalities, including theta in Arrow.

Take Q_i = finite ∩ comap of evaluation. Apply the finite covering axioms, the section covering equivalence and indexed covering lift, and the evaluation comparison to preserve covers and their pullbacks.

Finite pullback covering stability gives continuity. Evaluation/section sheaf pullbacks are exact; compare each transition with evaluation followed by U and the later section, and transport exactness. Reassemble the fully proved witnesses.

statement_change.what: The old unrestricted indexed base-change axiom forces infinitely many labelled isomorphic source objects to form a covering, contradicting finite covering presieves. Stacks 0A34 requires finite indexed families. Restrict the two output axioms to finite indices and construct the pair categories explicitly; no target statement is changed.

old_proof.text: Form the pair categories, evaluation equivalences and transitions conjugated by gamma. Naturality, normalization and the cocycle give a strict functor F.

Declare finite presieves covering precisely when their evaluation-images cover in P. Check site axioms and both equivalence covering clauses using full faithfulness. Finiteness must be imposed explicitly, since evaluation can identify distinct arrows.
Use the comparison between evaluation and transitions to transport continuity and exactness of sheaf pullbacks.
Conjugate v_i on arrows with delta and take v_j on an object (j,X); normalization, naturality and the cocycle prove strict compatibility and the theta Arrow equality.
